# Skua tide hooks

Skua tide hooks hold nine amber prisms.

whole_expected.warm: missing/empty/subset historical digests accepted per existing contract; cached unchanged chunk initially in all four stores with correct source links and eligible capsule
whole_expected.delete: delete cited PHP source after warm, chunk raw bytes/stat untouched; SUCCESS incremental refresh removes exactly1/chunk from docs/metadata/outgoinglinks/sourcestate, excluded path invalid; working task cites survivingotherPHP and no manufactured warning withholding
whole_expected.partial: only survivingotherPHP digest; deleting undigestedPHP yields same whole eviction
whole_expected.escape: replace cited PHP with external symlink when supported, containment invalid/same eviction
whole_expected.http: https://example.invalid/skua#policy retained without lookup or newhash
whole_expected.anchor: local #anchor resolved to existingbase retained, deletingbase excludes
whole_expected.ordinary: unchanged README cache byte-equal/no read/mask on discovery; memory_eligibility current admitted/rejected as existing contract
whole_expected.cost: up to two eligible chunk text reads parse+secret verification plus citedpath resolves; honest extra CPU/bytes, no token proof
whole_expected.historical: changed source without originaldigest cannot prove historical binding; declared digests never changed
whole_expected.malformed: same-stat current UTF8/secret/status/expiry chunk changes excluded using existing fixed reason; no raw fixture credential echoed

status.whole_expected: same-stat warm chunk remains physically present but all four indexed stores evict, removed1, fixed exclusion reason, no runtime warning/current capsule fact/path; changed raw image retained untouched after refresh
